data_description.scan_minutes: How often procyclingstats is queried outside of races.
data_description.live_scan_minutes: During a live stage, so the peloton's position keeps up.
data_description.extra_races: Races outside the WorldTour, comma separated, using the name procyclingstats uses — for example danmark-rundt. A full address from that site works too. They show up as a button in the pop-up.
data_description.extra_on_dashboard: Off: the tile keeps showing the WorldTour and the additional races only appear in the pop-up.
data_description.hidden_races: Races that never show up, written the same way.
data_description.max_other: 0 shows only the race on the tile. Every extra race costs requests at procyclingstats and room in the attributes.
